strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the trend using the fair value gap that caused a break of structure. Wait for price to retrace back into that FVG, preferably one close to an order block, and enter on the tap/retest for continuation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself: a little below the FVG for buys and a little above the FVG for sells. No concrete profit-target rule is taught beyond waiting for continuation in the trade direction.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the bullish FVG that caused break of structure; wait for price to tap back into it in-trend.
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the bearish FVG that caused break of structure; wait for price to return into it and then sell for continuation.
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

result.enumeration_note: One strategy is taught: an in-trend fair-value-gap retest continuation setup, shown in bullish and bearish directions as compatible directional variants with the same stop mechanic; no separate opposing or alternate exit skeleton is taught.
